spec.title: LLM Observability
spec.description: Requests, tokens, cost, latency and errors for apps instrumented with llm_telemetry.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: p95 time to first token by provider
spec.description: How long users wait before text starts appearing (streaming calls).

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider) (rate(llm_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (provider) (rate(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", status="error"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (provider) (rate(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Provider & model scorecard
spec.description: Side-by-side comparison for the selected time range.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (provider, model, le) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (provider, model, le) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

sum by (provider, model) (rate(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", status="error"}[$__range])) / sum by (provider, model) (rate(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))

sum by (provider, model) (increase(llm_tokens_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", token_type="output"}[$__range])) / sum by (provider, model) (increase(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", status="ok"}[$__range]))

sum by (provider, model) (increase(llm_cost_usd_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (provider, model) (increase(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", status="ok"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (provider, model, le) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

1000 * sum by (provider, model) (increase(llm_cost_usd_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / sum by (provider, model) (increase(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", status="ok"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Latency percentiles
spec.description: Full request duration, from send to last token.

spec.title: Time to first token percentiles
spec.description: Recorded for streaming calls (chat() streams by default; track() via call.first_token()).

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider, model) (rate(llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: p95 time to first token by model

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider, model) (rate(llm_time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Errors / min by type
spec.description: rate_limit_429, server_error_5xx, auth_401/403, client_error_4xx, timeout, connection_error.

spec.expr: sum by (provider, error_type) (rate(llm_requests_total{job=~"$service", provider=~"$provider", model=~"$model", status="error"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Recent LLM traces
spec.description: Click a trace ID to open it in Tempo.
